Statutory & Quality Framework

Compliance & Export Certifications

Rigorous regulatory adherence for international trade. Here is the complete breakdown of statutory registrations, food safety standards, and batch test certifications applicable to KSR International Trade Manufacturing.

Our Honest Verification-Upon-Request Protocol

In strict compliance with our transparency policy, we do not make inflated claims. Applicable business registrations, export licenses, batch-specific Certificates of Analysis (COA), and quarantine documentation are provided to international buyers upon formal inquiry, request, or purchase order verification.

Food Safety Compliance Govt. of India

1. FSSAI Certification

Food Safety and Standards Authority of India

Verifies food safety, hygienic handling, storage parameters, and sanitary manufacturing processes for agricultural and spice processing operations in India.

Coverage: Manufacturing facility & export dispatch
Verification: FSSAI license & registration details provided upon buyer request.
Official Spice Exporter Min. of Commerce

2. Spices Board of India

RCMC (Registration cum Membership Certificate)

The apex regulatory body under the Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Government of India. Authorizes and certifies genuine spice exporters for legitimate international trade.

Coverage: Whole spices, spice powders, and custom blends
Verification: RCMC exporter credentials verified upon formal trade enquiry.
Agri Export Council Agri Authority

3. APEDA Registration

Agri & Processed Food Products Authority

Ensures scheduled agricultural commodities, rice, seeds, and processed agri-products conform to export promotion rules and international shipment tracking standards.

Coverage: Agricultural commodities & export processing
Verification: Applicable APEDA registration shared during contract drafting.
Lab Batch Reports ISO/IEC 17025

4. Certificate of Analysis (COA)

Laboratory Physical, Chemical & Microbial Testing

Every export lot is tested according to buyer specifications. Laboratory parameters measured include moisture, volatile oil %, curcumin/capsaicin values, aflatoxins, and pesticide residues.

Key Parameters: Moisture %, Extraneous matter, ASTA color, SHU
Verification: Batch test reports issued by accredited laboratories per container.
Port & Quarantine Clearance IPPC Standard

5. Phytosanitary Certification

Plant Quarantine & Fumigation Protocols

Official phytosanitary certificate issued by plant protection authorities verifying cargo is free from quarantine pests, weeds, and harmful pathogens prior to container seal.

Fumigation: Methyl Bromide (MBr) or Aluminium Phosphide (ALP)
Verification: Government plant quarantine certificate attached to B/L.
DGFT Registered Exporter DGFT Approved

6. IEC & GST Registrations

Import Export Code (DGFT) & GST Compliance

Directorate General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) issued Import Export Code (IEC) and Goods & Services Tax (GST) registrations establishing legal export standing for containerized shipments.

Location: Ambad, Jalna, Maharashtra, India
Verification: Business registrations confirmed with proforma invoicing.

About KSR International Trade Manufacturing

We built our business around three core values: quality, transparency, and reliable supply. Export Documentation & Compliance Audit Guide

KSR International Trade Manufacturing • Indian Spice Export Verification

Buyer Verification Protocol

International buyers in UAE, Bangladesh, Oman, Malaysia, and worldwide require statutory proof before booking sea containers. In line with our core value of absolute honesty, all 6 critical export documents are made readily available upon formal request:

1. FSSAI Central / Manufacturing

Role: Validates food safety protocols, pest management, hygienic handling, and production compliance at our Maharashtra operations.

Verification: Registration number & certificate provided during quotation.

2. Spices Board of India (RCMC)

Role: Mandatory Registration-cum-Membership Certificate authorizing legitimate export shipments of Indian spices to global ports.

Verification: Exporter membership records verifiable with Spices Board of India.

3. APEDA Registration

Role: Agricultural & Processed Food Products Export Development Authority oversight for agricultural seeds and processed foods.

Verification: Shared alongside proforma invoice.

4. Certificate of Analysis (COA)

Role: Batch-specific lab tests verifying Curcumin %, Scoville Heat Units, moisture, total ash, Aflatoxin levels, and microbiological counts.

Verification: Accompanying every dispatched container consignment.

5. Phytosanitary & Fumigation

Role: Official plant quarantine clearance proving agricultural cargo is disinfected, insect-free, and safe for foreign port entry.

Verification: Original government quarantine certificate included in BL pack.

6. IEC & GST Registrations

Role: DGFT Import Export Code & GST registrations confirming legitimate corporate standing in Maharashtra, India.

Verification: Ready for verification on government trade portals.
